externalfield.help: Field given in x y z components

ecp.help: Effective Core Potentials for DFT Calculations

functional.help: Exchange correlation functional used. You can also specify an exchange and a correlation functional

dipole_spacing.help: Spacing for splitting multipoles into charges

temporary_file.help: Filename for temporary files without extension

convergence_tightness.help: How accurate the dft self-consistency has to be

cleanup.help: files to remove after the calculation. Specify the fileextensions

initial_guess.help: Method to use to make initial guess, independent(electrons) or atom(densities) or previous calculation keyword orbfile or dimer_guess (combine two monomer .orb files, see dimer_guess_orbA/orbB below; closed-shell monomers work for restricted and unrestricted runs, open-shell monomers need the unrestricted path)

dimer_guess_orbA.help: Path to monomer A's own, already-converged .orb file -- only read when initial_guess=dimer_guess. Monomer A's atoms must be an exact internal-geometry match (bond lengths/angles, NOT absolute position -- translation/rotation between the standalone monomer and its placement in the dimer is expected and fine) for the first N_A atoms of this calculation's own molecule.

dimer_guess_orbB.help: Same as dimer_guess_orbA, for monomer B -- expected to match this calculation's own remaining atoms (after monomer A's own N_A atoms).

orca.help: orca specific keywords can be added here, where the xml tag corresponds to the option and the value to the option's value

xtpdft.help: xtpdft specific keywords can be added here

activeatoms.help: Indices of atoms in active region

threshold.help: Mulliken population above which orbital is considered in the active region

levelshift.help: Levelshift energy for the projection operator

truncate_basis.help: Truncate the basis-set to active atoms only

truncation_threshold.help: Threshold to convert an inactive atom to a border atom

overlap_tolerance.help: Eigenvalues of the AO overlap matrix below this value are removed from the orthogonalization (near linear dependencies; the removed directions become zero orbitals at the top of the spectrum). Raise to 1e-7 to 1e-6 if the log reports a nearly singular overlap and the SCF is unstable.

ri_pair_threshold.help: RI only: basis-function shell pairs whose three-centre integrals (P|ab) are bounded by less than this (Schwarz bound) are not stored. Reduces the memory of the stored RI tensor substantially for large molecules; energies change at the level of the threshold. 0 stores all pairs.

fock_matrix_reset.help: how often the fock matrix is reset

compute_forces.help: Compute analytic ground-state DFT nuclear forces (RI, and hybrid-exchange for UKS) and store them in the orb (HDF5) file. Adds real cost to every converged SCF, so this is opt-in.

cdft.help: Constrained DFT (CDFT): a Hirshfeld-based charge constraint on a fragment of the molecule, via an outer, warm-started Lagrange-multiplier loop around the ordinary UKS SCF (Wu-Van Voorhis approach). Opt-in via cdft.enabled -- has no effect on any calculation unless explicitly enabled, matching compute_forces's own opt-in convention just above.

enabled.help: Enable a CDFT charge constraint on this calculation

indices.help: Indices of atoms in the constrained fragment (0-based), using the same range syntax already used for diabatization.xml's own fragment indices, e.g. '1 3 13:17'

charge.help: Target charge on the fragment, RELATIVE to its neutral reference state (the sum of the fragment atoms' own nuclear charges) -- e.g. +1.0 means one electron REMOVED from the fragment (a cation), -1.0 means one electron ADDED (an anion). Converted internally to an absolute target electron count once, at setup time.

initial_lambda.help: Initial guess for the Lagrange multiplier lambda, used as the center of the outer loop's own bisection bracket

population_tolerance.help: Outer-loop convergence criterion: the CDFT calculation is considered converged once the achieved fragment population is within this many electrons of the target

max_iterations.help: Maximum number of outer (Lagrange-multiplier, bisection) iterations -- each one is a full, warm-started inner SCF

guess_strategy.help: How each outer bisection trial's own inner SCF is started, after the very first trial. 'warmstart' (default) reuses the immediately PRECEDING trial's own converged MOs (initial_guess is forced to 'orbfile' internally) for every subsequent trial -- usually helps, since consecutive lambda values are often close. 'fresh' instead re-uses the calculation's own original, top-level initial_guess setting for every trial, never warm-starting from a previous lambda's own MOs at all -- worth trying if warm-starting itself seems to be part of a convergence difficulty (e.g. if consecutive lambda trials correspond to substantially different electronic structures, a previous trial's own converged density could be a worse starting point than a fresh guess, not a better one).

energy.help: DeltaE at which calculation is converged

method.help: Main method to use for convergence accelertation

DIIS_start.help: DIIS error at which DIIS takes over

ADIIS_start.help: DIIS error at which ADIIS takes over

DIIS_length.help: old hamiltonians to keep in history

DIIS_maxout.help: if true remove the maximum element in the history if DIIS_length is exceeded.Otherwise, the oldest element is removed.

levelshift_end.help: DIIS error at levelshifting is disabled

mixing.help: mixing parameter for linear mixing of density matrices

mixing_end.help: DIIS error below which mixing is disabled -- independent of ADIIS_start (see ORCA's own DampErr, kept independent of DIISStart for the same reason: difficult systems benefit from keeping mixing active well past the point where ADIIS/DIIS themselves start being tried, not exactly until that same point). Defaults to match ADIIS_start's own default (0.8) for backward compatibility -- existing configurations see identical behavior unless this is set explicitly.

mixing_max.help: Ceiling mixing can adaptively ramp up toward as the SCF struggles (see consecutive ADIIS failures), rather than staying fixed at the base mixing value for an entire run. Matches ORCA's own DampMax (default 0.98, confirmed directly from a real ORCA log's own resolved SCF settings) -- ORCA ramps its own damping factor from a base (DampFac, 0.7 by default) up to this ceiling only when actually needed, rather than paying the cost of heavy damping throughout.

energy_reset.help: If the energy rises by more than this above the lowest energy reached so far, the (A)DIIS history is discarded and the SCF restarts, damped, from the lowest-energy density. 0 disables.

davidson_max_iter.help: Maximum iterations for the Davidson eigensolver used by the direct-minimization (augmented-Hessian) fallback, engaged when ADIIS/DIIS themselves are struggling. A genuinely difficult system (e.g. a strong constraint spanning a large fragment) can leave this solver still short of its own convergence tolerance at the default -- confirmed directly, from a real run, that the previous, hardcoded 50 was not always enough. Not CDFT-specific: this fallback can also engage for an ordinary, non-CDFT UKS calculation.
